notes:
Second release candidate for 2.2.0, for playtesting. Foundry v14, PF2e or SF2e.

Everything in rc.1 (classes, powers, grenades, mods, backgrounds), plus:

C-Sec officers

Seven generic statblocks in ME NPCs → Citadel & Council: Desk Officer (0), Patrol Officer (1), Forensics Technician (1), Enforcement Officer (2), Detective (3), Tactical Officer (4) and Captain (5). They have no species trait, so add one to match the officer you place. Token art is a placeholder for now.

Shields fixed across the bestiary

Every NPC, creature and vehicle now carries the module's own Kinetic Shield, Shield HP Mod and Shield Regen Mod items, with shield HP that matches its gear.

  • 23 enemies' shields never worked: their Kinetic Shield had no shield data, so it never recharged. Fixed.
  • Shield sizes now land on the real gear totals (30, 40, 50, 70, 100). Some enemies moved slightly; the Asari Justicar and Krogan Battlemaster drop to 100.
  • Low-level combatants with 10–25 shields now carry the standard 30. Civilians (Hanar Keeper, Volus Merchant, Conrad Verner) carry none.
  • Banshee, Praetorian and the Harbinger-Possessed Collector were effectively getting their barrier twice; they now have only the barrier.
  • Reaper armor-only enemies (Brute, Cannibal, Harvester, Ravager, Scion) lost a stray layer of shields; the geth Armature, Colossus and Heretic Geth got real shield gear in its place.

Please test

The rc.1 checklist still applies. Also: 1. Drop a few enemies (a geth, a Blue Suns Trooper, a Banshee) and check their shield and barrier bars match their statblocks. 2. Damage a shielded enemy and confirm the shield recharges on its turn.

Full details in the release notes.
